name: review-3360
description: Optimize WATCH duplicate key check from O(N) to O(1) using per-db hashtable
author: enjoy-binbin

maintainer_comments.author: enjoy-binbin
maintainer_comments.body:
We can not call WATCH in a MULTI, so i think we are safe here.
ie we can only call WATCH before a MULTI, and in this case, there are not transaction_db_id at all.

maintainer_comments.author: enjoy-binbin
maintainer_comments.body:
I did consider that, but ultimately decided doing this PR way. If a client has used WATCH in the past, it should continue to use WATCH in the future.

But i am open for this one, let's see what other people think.
